title: Invisible Armor Stands
description: This resource pack makes armor stands invisible while keeping all their functionality. Perfect for map makers, builders, decoration setups, and custom displays in Minecraft.
body:
This resource pack makes armor stands invisible while keeping all their functionality.
Perfect for builders, decoration setups, and custom displays in Minecraft.

 Features
- Invisible armor stands
- Works in survival and creative
- Great for decorative builds
- Compatible with most texture packs
- Lightweight and simple
